argv:
Diff size probe. Read the full PR diff with this one command in the checkout:
# base = PR merge-base b09bf14035518dc522f434c484db1e8517da14e4
# head = current verified head e6c03ab1e3792c5348cbef7dd6f269ca6a2fe6a8
# Full PR diff: old = merge-base (base); new = head
git --no-replace-objects diff --no-color --no-ext-diff --no-textconv --no-relative --src-prefix=a/ --dst-prefix=b/ --find-renames b09bf14035518dc522f434c484db1e8517da14e4...e6c03ab1e3792c5348cbef7dd6f269ca6a2fe6a8 --

Run it with Bash exactly once, unchanged. Then report:
- handed_whole: whether the Bash result you were handed holds the entire diff output, or was cut or saved elsewhere.
- sentinel_seen: whether you have seen the line +SENTINEL-END-OF-DIFF, the last line of the diff.
- If you were not handed the whole diff, try to reach the rest with the tools you are allowed (Read, Glob, Grep). Do not run any other Bash command. Set reached_rest to whether you saw the rest, through bulk line 07999 and the sentinel.
- how: exactly what the tool result said about size or truncation, any file path it named, and what each attempt to reach the rest returned.
